findings.text: The base arm's provenance header (revision, tree, cwd, module.__file__) was stripped by relabel_logs.py, leaving only a '# command:' first line, and the scratch base tree under /tmp is gone, so the delivered log no longer shows which revision the base arm measured; the manifest's measurement_module/measurement_cwd fields carry it but the log a reader opens does not.

No test fails if committed_head is re-introduced; the done_when's guard is a one-shot git grep recorded only in logs/grep-head.log, so a future change restoring the dead reader passes the whole suite undetected.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base b97740c8; 450ba34c4 deletes committed_head from reckon/checkout_trust.py and dbd1689f1 only trims a meta line in the new evidence fragment, nothing outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names git grep -nw committed_head -- reckon tests at base (prints the definition) and head (prints nothing) plus the checkout_trust importers' failure delta; I reproduced base EXIT=0 with the def at line 208 and head EXIT=1 with no output, and the importer logs record 101 passed on both arms.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to remove the uncalled committed_head reader from reckon/checkout_trust.py; the diff deletes exactly that function, 16 lines, with no other change.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reports committed_head removed, the grep base/head EXITs, the importer suite 101/101 with 0 added failures, and ruff clean; its test_logs resolve to the run's logs directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared write paths are reckon/checkout_trust.py and the two docs/evidence|figures fragment paths; every path the diff changes is inside them.

justifications.durability: No test in the suite fails if committed_head is re-added; the done_when gate is a one-shot git grep recorded only in logs/grep-head.log, not a regression guard.
justifications.evidence: Importer logs importer-tests-base.log and importer-tests-head.log both record 101 passed with 0 added failures, but the base arm's revision/tree/module header lines were stripped by relabel_logs.py, so the reviewed run's baseline_suite/after_suite arms carry no self-evident revision.
justifications.fit: The deletion leaves reckon/checkout_trust.py:208 committed_reckon_tree in place with the surrounding module style intact, and both commits use conventional subjects with bodies and no AI attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/checkout_trust.py loses only the 16-line committed_head def and its docstring, matching the goal to remove that reader exactly.
justifications.reuse: The diff adds no definition or capability (it deletes a function and adds a doc fragment), so no repository-owned mechanism is forked; a search over reckon/ for a dead-code absence guard found none to duplicate.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff touches only reckon/checkout_trust.py and the always-permitted landing fragment docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/the-unused-commit-reader-goes.html, both inside the declared write paths.
